conditions: recover and hash-verify exact historical OpenPI/RoboLab revisions
pass a new v3 model-specific fixed-observation repeat and LEFT/RIGHT prompt-sensitivity release
optional_model_after_independent_release.accounting: Not included in the frozen three-checkpoint Phase C denominator or episode total.

shared_matched_pairs.matching: Every model uses the same 20 seed/reset identities. Within a model, seed, and wording form, LEFT and RIGHT share the same neutral reset, runtime identity, controller, action contract, and sampling seed.

direct_command.left: Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
direct_command.right: Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl.

short_command.left: Put the cube left of the bowl.
short_command.right: Put the cube right of the bowl.

goal_as_outcome.left: The Rubik's cube should end up to the left of the bowl.
goal_as_outcome.right: The Rubik's cube should end up to the right of the bowl.

desired_plus_negated_opposite.left: Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl, not to the right of the bowl.
desired_plus_negated_opposite.right: Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl, not to the left of the bowl.

randomization: Before any Phase C inference, a hash-pinned randomization manifest jointly assigns the four prompt-form and LEFT/RIGHT execution orders within each checkpoint/seed. The direct command is the within-seed control; no prompt changes during an episode.
